verdict.rationale: treg's own `balance` command reports the selected team's prepaid balance and daily usage, and calls are metered per call. That gives the team a thin, first-party view of consumption and spend. The catalog's success rate, speed and price figures describe providers in general, not the org's own usage, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: per-tool or per-server call-volume breakdowns, per-user attribution, error-rate analytics for the org's calls, cost broken down by tool, analytics on tools the org publishes, any dashboard or analytics API documentation, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see usage analytics for the servers and tools my org consumes or publishes — call volumes, users, errors, and cost

citations.quote: `balance` reports the selected team's prepaid balance and daily usage.
A prepaid balance, metered per call at the provider's own rate, with no markup.
